text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I headed to the racetrack and 
saw an Umamusume intently reading a racing 
paper...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...! I-I'm sorry! Was I standing in your 
way...?
choice_data_list:
No, not at all! I was just admiring your 
dedication.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Oh my, no way...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wait... an academy Trainer...? I see... 
today is... a high-profile showdown, after 
all.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it!
Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! It is no exaggeration to say 
today's race will write a brand-new page 
in history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we talked about racing, conversation 
naturally drifted toward predicting the 
winning Umamusume. We kept our voices low 
so those around wouldn't overhear.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――I see. Indeed, that girl is also stiff. 
As expected of your sharp eye.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ........Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Past data aside, what I'm keeping a close 
eye on today is 'how the race as a whole 
unfolds'...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Based on this information, let's try to 
make specific predictions on how the race 
will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
First, looking at the runners' running 
styles... These two are front-runners, 
while the favorites will close from 
behind... We can anticipate a slow pace.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the front-runners will hold 
on... These two girls, who look capable of 
conserving their stamina while running, 
will likely have the advantage...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However—looking at the final 3 furlongs 
from this chaser's previous race... she's 
fast. And to clock this time despite the 
high pace...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If she can unleash a burst of speed like 
that on Tokyo's long home straight, 
passing even the race favorites in one 
breath is well within the realm of 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ――A-And so...! ...She's coming...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her view differed from my prediction. 
Whose analysis would prove correct...? 
Before long, the gates sprang open...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A slow pace in the early stages. From the 
lead to the rear is about ten lengths, as 
the pack moves forward tightly bunched 
together.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Just 600 meters to go! She makes her move 
all at once! She's surging forward! What 
an incredible late charge!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――GOOOOOOOAL!!! With magnificent 
razor-sharp acceleration, she sweeps past 
them from dead last~~!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! It's beyond anything I imagined...! 
That was truly... a magnificent race.
choice_data_list:
Incredible...! It turned out just like you 
said!

Incredible...! It turned out just like you 
said!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Looks like... I hit the mark 
today. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What a razor-sharp prediction...! My own 
assessment still has a long way to go. 
I've received some truly inspiring food 
for thought!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What a razor-sharp prediction...! My own 
assessment still has a long way to go. 
I've received some truly inspiring food 
for thought!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A special talent...? Oh, no... I-I'm 
flattered, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I just... love racing, and I've watched a 
lot of them... that's all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Likewise... thank you. I usually watch 
them alone, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Making race predictions with someone else 
is quite nice once in a while...
